top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 89, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
GFNY Dominican Republic's rolling hills rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Dominican Republic's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
When someone attacks on rolling hills, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 89 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Dominican Republic. Train it until it feels boring.

Road-specific control matters at GFNY Dominican Republic. Practice on rolling hills: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 89 miles.
At GFNY Dominican Republic, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
The aerobic base that lets you ride rolling hills at tempo for 89 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
2-minute all-out efforts on rolling hills. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 89 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what GFNY Dominican Republic's rolling hills actually does to you.

race_overlay.heat: September in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Dominican Republic. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for GFNY Dominican Republic’s 89 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 89 miles of rolling hills in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.
